_meta.directives: Dossier fondé sur des sources externes, dont plusieurs communautaires ; ne pas étendre les affirmations sans source dédiée.

linguisticReconstructions.claim: The dictionary of jamuw places Samasa among the jamuw of the Wago subdivision, one of the three great divisions of Soninke society whose origin is traced to Wagadu, and links the entry to the Soninke.
A Soninke community list attaches two second names (jammu kare) to Samassa, Dioura and Yaraguilé, and contributors to a Soninke community forum place it among names of Soninke origin.

sources.title: Bamadaba — dictionnaire des noms claniques (jamuw)
sources.notes: Onomastic annex of the Bamadaba, an electronic Bambara-French dictionary supplementing the Corpus bambara de référence (Bailleul, Davydov, Erman, Maslinsky, Méric, Vydrin, 2011-2020, CC BY-NC-SA); the annex of clan names is identified as such by Vydrin, "Vers une lexicographie mandingue sur la base de grands corpus annotés", Mandenkan 63, 2020, pp. 89-110. 375 entries in MDF format, consulted in the complete file. The file provides no legend for its markers: the line of status terms carries the Mande words themselves; the group marker son is confirmed by the notice of the Wago entry, which lists Soninke jamuw, and the marker m is taken as a Malinke indicator by comparison with the Kéyità entry, which another of our fiches documents as a Malinke jamu; the other group markers are not used here. The free notes of the entries are written in Russian and translated here by us. The Samasa entry carries the group marker son and the single status wage. The notice of the Wago entry lists Samasa among its jamuw.

sources.title: Les noms de famille avec leur jammu kare
sources.notes: Soninke community portal, a social organisation page with no identified academic author: a non-exhaustive list, compiled by the portal's users, of second names (jammu kare) given to Soninke family names. The jammu kare is, the page says, the second name that is added to a family name and serves as its identifier. Consulted in an archived copy of 12 December 2024. Only the presence of the name in the list and its second names are taken from it here: the list says nothing about their origin.

sources.title: Les noms de Famille d'Origine Soninké
sources.notes: Discussion thread on the forum of the Soninkara.com community portal, opened in December 2006 and continued until 2011: contributors, under pseudonyms, compile lists of names they hold to be Soninke. The lists partly overlap and contradict one another: several participants point out that many names borne today by Soninke people are not Soninke in origin, and one of them asks that Soninke names be distinguished from names of Soninke origin. Consulted in an archived copy from 2024.

sources.title: Samassa — origine, signification et incidence du nom de famille
sources.notes: Global genealogy aggregator, consulted on 29 September 2026. Worldwide incidence of about 10,205 bearers; Mali 8,648, Mauritania 586, Senegal 428, Côte d'Ivoire 186, Italy 110, France 85. The page gives no meaning for the name. The figures for countries outside Africa are not included in the attestations of this fiche.
